title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Bryson Co-Leads LIV Korea
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau tied for the Day 1 lead at 5-under alongside Charles Howell III and Scott Vincent in LIV Golf Korea and praised the league's team format, with his Crushers team leading the team race amid Saudi PIF's reported exit after 2026.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Skips 2026 Majors
items.text: Tiger Woods is not expected to compete in any of the 2026 major championships, raising questions about the future of his major championship career.
